facts.activity_file: isolating and depressuring a leaking system
facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

assets.label: hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel
assets.service: diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression

control_failures.control_label: controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: hazard report during shift handover on TK-4211

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on TK-4211 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. TK-4211 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during shift handover while the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 11 February 2015 a hazard report was recorded on TK-4211 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during shift handover; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
